params.name: tickers
params.description: One or more ticker symbols to map. Can be repeated multiple times, e.g., `tickers=AAPL&tickers=GOOG`.

items.docs: Accepts a list of ticker strings via query parameters and returns their corresponding stock IDs (BBG IDs).

params.name: document_id
params.description: Document ID

items.docs:
Generates a temporary presigned URL for secure access to the original document file.

Provide a `document_id` (obtained from the References API) to receive a time-limited (10 min) URL that allows you to download or view the source document directly. This is useful when you need to access the actual file that was referenced in the search results.

params.name: tickers
params.description: Ticker symbol(s) to filter by. At least one ticker or stock_id is required. Use multiple `tickers` params for multiple tickers (e.g., `?tickers=AAPL&tickers=MSFT`).

params.name: stock_ids
params.description: Stock ID(s) to filter by. Can be used instead of or together with `tickers`.

params.name: doc_type
params.description: Document type filter (e.g., `filing`, `earnings_call`)

params.name: doc_sub_type
params.description: Document sub-type filter (e.g., `10-K`, `10-Q`, `annual_report`, `press_release`)

params.name: fiscal_period
params.description: Fiscal period filter. Use nested object notation in the query string (e.g., `fiscal_period[start_time][year]=2024&fiscal_period[start_time][quarter]=1`).

params.name: calendar_period
params.description: Calendar period filter. Use nested object notation in the query string (e.g., `calendar_period[start_time][year]=2025&calendar_period[start_time][month]=1`).

params.name: page
params.description: Page number (default: 1)

params.name: per_page
params.description: Number of results per page (default: 20, max: 200)

items.docs:
Generates temporary presigned URLs for multiple documents in a single request.

Filter documents by ticker, document type, and date ranges. Returns paginated results with presigned URLs and document metadata.

This is useful when you need to download multiple source documents at once, rather than calling the single-document presigned URL endpoint repeatedly.

params.name: search_type
params.description: Document source. `external` (default) returns external documents. `rms` returns documents from your Research Management System (RMS).

params.name: organization_id
params.description: Organization ID. Recommended for `search_type=rms` and required for platform API keys. If omitted, defaults to the API key's primary organization.

items.docs:
Generates a temporary presigned URL for secure access to a document file. Supports both external documents (filings, transcripts, news) and RMS documents (Third Bridge transcripts, internal notes, EDS content).

Use `search_type=rms` to access RMS documents. Default is `external` (same behavior as V1).

For platform API keys, pass `organization_id` to specify which org's documents to query. If omitted, defaults to the API key's primary organization.

items.docs:
Generates temporary presigned URLs for multiple documents. Supports both external documents and RMS documents via the `search_type` parameter.

**Two modes:**
- **By document IDs** (RMS only): Pass `document_ids` to get presigned URLs for specific documents from search/analytics references.
- **By filters**: Pass `tickers`, `doc_type`, etc. to browse and get presigned URLs.

For platform API keys, pass `organization_id` to specify which org to query.
